resolved.title: 第一个C++程序
resolved.description:
[s0l0!-header][h1]Your First C++ Program  [/h1][/s0l0!-header] 

Let's output "Hello world!" to the screen!
To do that, we will add [b]cout << "Hello world!"; [/b]line to our main() function body:
[code format="cpp" codeId="3840"]#include <iostream>
using namespace std;

int main()
{
  [b]cout << "Hello world!";[/b]
  [b]cout << " This " << "is " << "awesome!";[/b]
  return 0;
}[/code]
[b]cout[/b] is used to perform output on the standard output device which is usually the display screen.
cout[b] [/b]is used in combination with the [b]insertion operator <<[/b].
Note that you can add [b]multiple[/b] insertion operators after cout. 
[note]In C++, the semicolon is used to terminate a statement. Each statement must end with a semicolon. It indicates the end of one logical expression.[/note]

content.text:
让我们向屏幕输出 "Hello world!"!

要做到这一点，只需在`main()`函数主体中添加一行`cout << "Hello world!";` 即可。
content.text_html:
Let's output "Hello world!" to the screen! To do that, we will add **cout << "Hello world!"; **line to our main() function body:

让我们向屏幕输出 "Hello world!"! 要做到这一点，我们将在main()函数主体中添加**cout << "Hello world!"; **line。

content.text:
**cout**用于在标准输出设备上进行输出，该设备通常是显示屏幕。

**cout** 与**插入操作符**`<<`结合使用。
注意，你可以在cout后面添加**多个**插入操作符`<<`。
content.text_html:
cout is used to perform output on the standard output device which is usually the display screen. cout** **is used in combination with the insertion operator <<. Note that you can add multiple insertion operators after cout.

content.text: 在C++中，分号`;`用于终止一个语句。每个语句必须以分号`;`结束。它表示一个逻辑表达式的结束。
content.text_html:
In C++, the semicolon is used to terminate a statement. Each statement must end with a semicolon. It indicates the end of one logical expression.

在C++中，分号用于终止一个语句。每个语句必须以分号结束。它表示一个逻辑表达式的结束。

注意，字母`C`是**大写字母**
resolved.problem_statement_en_md:
[s0l0!-header][h1]Your First C++ Program[/h1][/s0l0!-header]

Write a program to print "C++ is cool".
Note that the sentence starts with a [b]capital letter[/b].

[b]Hint[/b]
Use [b]cout[/b] and [b]insertion operator <<[/b] to output the text.

[note]Remember to enclose the text into [b]double quotes[/b] and end the statement with a [b]semicolon (;)[/b].[/note]
resolved.hint_md:
- 使用`cout<<`输出文本。
- 记住将文本前后需要加**双引号**`"`，并用**分号**`;`结束语句。
